runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid 7f form who should track the leader perfectly and has Harry Vigors' 5lb claim to offset his 134lbs burden.

runners_data.name: Diamont Katie
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer coming off a quick turnaround who needs a strong pace to be effective and has the highest TopSpeed rating of 77.

runners_data.name: Noble Guest
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from a 189-day break for an out-of-form yard but has shown ability at this trip when fresh.

runners_data.name: Way To Dubai
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose record shows limited success on good going with just 1 placing from 15 attempts on similar conditions.

runners_data.name: Mr Ubiquitous
runners_data.note: Front runner in excellent recent form who should get an uncontested lead and has won 4 from his last 15 starts at this distance.

runners_data.name: Dancing Terror
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making seasonal return from 20 days off for a trainer with limited recent runners but showed promise when winning last time out.

races.paceDynamic: Mr Ubiquitous will lead from the gates with Me Tarzan and Noble Guest tracking closely in prominent positions, creating a sustainable early tempo over this 7f trip. The three hold-up horses (Diamont Katie, Way To Dubai, Dancing Terror) will settle at the back, relying on the pace to develop. With only one confirmed front runner and willing prominent runners, the pace should be even rather than frantic, allowing the early leaders to maintain their advantage. This race shape favours prominent runners who can press the pace and kick clear, as the hold-up horses may find insufficient tempo to close effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Ubiquitous sets steady fractions and Me Tarzan/Noble Guest track smoothly
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows the prominent trio to stretch clear turning for home, with hold-up horses struggling to make ground on the leaders. Mr Ubiquitous and Me Tarzan have the tactical advantage and finishing kicks to prevail.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes more testing than expected between the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Diamont Katie and Way To Dubai get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kicks, sweeping past tiring leaders. The extra furlong gives them time to reel in the prominent pack who went too fast early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mr Ubiquitous Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader dictates soft fractions and kicks clear at the perfect moment
scenarios.body: Mr Ubiquitous uses his front-running style to maximum effect, opening up daylight in the straight while others struggle to respond. His recent Southwell success shows he can dominate from the front when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint from the 2f marker
scenarios.body: All six runners converge in a blanket finish where jockey tactics and a horse's turn of foot matter most. Dancing Terror's fresh return could surprise while others may get caught flat-footed in the sudden acceleration.

watchPoints.text: Mr Ubiquitous could steal this if he gets soft early fractions and no prominent runner puts him under pressure before the 2f marker.
Watch Diamont Katie's early positioning as she needs to be handy enough to strike if the pace doesn't develop as expected.
Noble Guest's fitness after 189 days off could be exposed if the race becomes a test of stamina rather than speed.
Way To Dubai's poor record on good going suggests he may struggle despite carrying less weight than his main rivals.
Monitor how aggressively Me Tarzan's inexperienced jockey Harry Vigors positions him in the early stages.

runners_data.name: Creative Queen

runners_data.name: Unique Procedure

runners_data.name: Shining Guest

runners_data.name: Izzy Fast

races.paceDynamic: Nevasca Cinza and Firewalker will contest the early lead in this small field, with Nevasca Cinza showing more consistent pace-setting ability based on her recent 6f efforts. Shining Guest may sit just off the pace but returns from a 277-day break, leaving the two leaders to set honest fractions without much pressure. The hold-up horses Creative Queen, Unique Procedure, and Izzy Fast will need the leaders to go hard enough to set up their finishing kicks. This pace setup favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike, as the two confirmed leaders may soften each other up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both Nevasca Cinza and Firewalker engage in a prolonged speed duel through the first 3f
scenarios.body: The early pace burns out both leaders, creating perfect setup conditions for the hold-up horses to close strongly. Creative Queen's class advantage and Haggas stable form make her the primary beneficiary of a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Nevasca Cinza Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Nevasca Cinza can dictate moderate fractions while Firewalker settles behind her
scenarios.body: The class leader gets easy leads and has enough left to hold off challengers, using her superior form figures and recent race fitness. Her ability to handle good ground and proven 6f record give her tactical control.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Firewalker Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Firewalker shows significant improvement from his July run and gets first run on rivals
scenarios.body: The Kevin Philippart De Foy runner finds the drop in grade suits and his fresher legs tell late after recent disappointment. Egan's booking suggests connections expect better.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shining Guest Returns Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the 277-day absence has done Shining Guest good and he can overcome ring rust
scenarios.body: The long break was intentional preparation and his previous 6f form at Yarmouth gives him course advantage. Ghiani can use his prominent style to track the leaders and pounce.

watchPoints.text: Nevasca Cinza and Firewalker going too fast early - if they're clear after 2f the pace could collapse
Creative Queen's ability to get competitive position from hold-up style with Fallon's aggressive riding
Shining Guest showing signs of ring rust or sharpness in early stages after the long layoff
Unique Procedure finding trouble in running from the rear with inexperienced 7lb claimer Dylan Hogan
Whether Firewalker can reproduce his Windsor second rather than his latest Sandown disappointment

races.paceDynamic: Sea Mehalah Run will lead this field without serious early pressure, setting her own tempo through steady fractions over this 1m2f trip at Yarmouth. The pack of hold-up horses including Montu, Lucky Sevens, and Darkest Red will settle well back, relying on the straight to make their moves. With no genuine speed merchants to apply early pressure, Sea Mehalah Run can dictate terms from the front. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their runs from off the pace, as the lone leader is vulnerable to being swamped in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Mehalah Run sets moderate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get ideal conditions to wind up from the back, overwhelming the isolated leader in the final two furlongs. Montu and Lucky Sevens are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Mehalah Run kicks clear turning for home before closers respond
scenarios.body: Her early advantage proves decisive as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the extended straight. The lack of early pace actually helps her conserve energy for a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses positions closer than usual early
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while avoiding traffic problems that may hinder those further back. Fletcher or Keep It Classic could benefit from more aggressive tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and stamina becomes paramount
scenarios.body: The longer trip exposes some runners while suiting an overlooked stayer. Sporty Socks' best form came over similar distances and could emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Sea Mehalah Run's market position given her 152-day absence and known tendency to weaken late
How aggressively Lucky Sevens is ridden early given his recent good form and top jockey booking
Whether any of the hold-up horses position closer to the pace than their usual style suggests
Private Project's jumping tactics as he drops back from hurdles to flat racing
The sectional times if Sea Mehalah Run dictates a slow early pace from the front

runners_data.name: Sword Of Wessex
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Silvestre De Sousa booking who may reluctantly lead given the lack of pace, but hasn't won for over a year despite consistent efforts.

runners_data.name: One Million Dreams
runners_data.note: Recent Catterick winner who thrives in small fields and tactical affairs, though Kyle McHugh's 7lb claim reduces experience advantage in tight finishes.

runners_data.name: Pershalla
runners_data.note: Last-time-out Yarmouth winner over course and distance with Cieren Fallon's tactical nous a key asset in what promises to be a tactical race.

runners_data.name: Atlantic Sunset
runners_data.note: Longest absence of 83 days is a concern despite previous course form, and needs to prove fitness against three rivals in better recent form.

races.paceDynamic: With all four runners showing hold-up tendencies and no confirmed early pace, this shapes as a crawling affair early with Sword Of Wessex likely reluctantly taking them along at a modest gallop. The lack of natural pace-setters means the tempo will be sedate through the middle sections, setting up a sprint finish from the three-furlong pole. One Million Dreams and Pershalla both possess recent winning form and should benefit most from this tactical setup. This race shape strongly favours horses with a sharp turn of foot who can quicken off a slow pace, giving the edge to those with recent form momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Sword Of Wessex sets a pedestrian early gallop with no pressure from behind.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who has the sharpest acceleration in the final two furlongs rather than stamina. One Million Dreams' recent Catterick win and Pershalla's last-time-out success at Yarmouth both came in similar tactical scenarios.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If the pace lifts gradually from halfway as jockeys start to position for home.
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine test of stamina over the extended trip, suiting horses who can grind out their finish. Sword Of Wessex's hold-up style becomes more effective when he can pick off tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Scrap For Position
scenarios.trigger: If multiple jockeys decide not to sit and wait, creating unexpected early pace pressure.
scenarios.body: The race becomes more demanding and suits horses with proven stamina reserves over this longer trip. Atlantic Sunset's extended absence becomes less of a concern if the race becomes a true staying test rather than a sprint.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If all four continue waiting in the back half until very late, creating a messy finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery dependent on who gets the clearest run and room to maneuver in a bunched finish. Cieren Fallon's big-race experience on Pershalla could prove decisive in navigating traffic problems.

watchPoints.text: Atlantic Sunset showing any signs of rustiness early given the 83-day layoff against three sharper rivals.
The pace through the first half-mile as all four prefer to sit off the pace, potentially creating a crawling gallop.
Sword Of Wessex's position turning in, as Silvestre De Sousa may need to commit earlier than ideal if setting the pace.
One Million Dreams getting a clear run in the straight given the small field could bunch up in the final furlong.
Pershalla's course familiarity advantage after winning here last time versus the other three who haven't won at Yarmouth recently.

races.paceDynamic: Shallow provides the only confirmed pace angle as a front-runner, meaning she can dictate terms from the start without pressure from other natural leaders. Havana Pusey and Ironist may track her in prominent positions, but the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including Miss Nightfall, Lady Manzor, Bridget's View and Lady Mariko who will need the race to develop. With minimal early pace pressure, Shallow can control fractions and potentially steal a march on the closers. This setup clearly favours horses that can sit close to the pace or those with the tactical speed to overcome a potentially slow early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shallow Controls Fractions
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow gets soft fractions without early pressure from Havana Pusey or Ironist
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal splits and prove difficult to peg back over this trip with her recent form uptick. The hold-up brigade faces a tactical disadvantage if the pace is too steady early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Pusey and Ironist both track Shallow closely and apply pressure
scenarios.body: This creates a faster gallop that suits the hold-up horses who can finish strongly. Miss Nightfall and Lady Mariko benefit from stronger pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow goes too slow and the prominent horses fail to engage
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn favouring horses with natural finishing kick. Lady Mariko's recent win suggests she has the tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate but honest throughout allowing versatile runners to position
scenarios.body: Horses that can adapt their running style gain advantage over one-dimensional runners. This rewards tactical jockeys over rigid front-runners or hold-up merchants.

watchPoints.text: Shallow's ability to get away with soft fractions early will determine if the hold-up horses get their preferred strong gallop
Lady Mariko's tactical positioning given her versatility could prove crucial if David Egan can secure the ideal stalking berth
Havana Pusey's recent form decline may continue despite her prominent running style suiting the likely pace scenario
Jack Dace's 5lb claim on Lady Manzor brings her down to a competitive weight despite stepping up in grade
Miss Nightfall's 31-day absence could either freshen her up or leave her needing the run after the layoff

races.paceDynamic: Dion Baker and Top Biller will contest the early lead in this 9-runner handicap, with both confirmed front-runners unlikely to give an inch through the opening exchanges. Grand Citadel and Sir Rodneyredblood should track the pace prominently, while the six hold-up horses including Griselda, Moonhall Lass, and Edergole's Gift will be relying on a strong gallop to set up their finishing kicks. The dual pace angle creates an honest tempo that should play into the hands of the prominent runners who can position close enough to strike without getting embroiled in the early battle. This race shape clearly favours horses that can race handy and pick up the pieces when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early duel between Dion Baker and Top Biller becomes overly fierce through honest fractions
scenarios.body: The front two will weaken markedly in the final furlong, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past with strong late runs. Horses like Edergole's Gift and Moonhall Lass can capitalise on their class edge when the pace falls apart.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Citadel or Sir Rodneyredblood can position perfectly behind the battling leaders without getting involved
scenarios.body: They can time their move to perfection as the pace-setters weaken, striking at the ideal moment when the closers still have ground to make up. The prominent style proves the tactical masterstroke in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Dion Baker or Top Biller can steal a march on their rival and dictate more manageable fractions
scenarios.body: The survivor can kick clear turning for home before the closers can organise their challenge, holding on grimly to the line. The class horse Top Biller looks the more likely to execute this tactical coup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is surprisingly steady with both leaders showing restraint early on
scenarios.body: A bunched finish develops where any of the nine can win in a dash from the furlong pole, making draw and racing room crucial factors. The most progressive types like No Gain can capitalise on the tactical nature.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Dion Baker and Top Biller to go too hard too early, as both are confirmed pace-setters who may not give an inch to each other.
Keep an eye on Sir Rodneyredblood's fitness after his 52-day absence, as the 9-year-old needs to be spot-on to be competitive.
Monitor the positioning of Edergole's Gift early, as the top-rated horse needs the leaders to go a strong gallop to showcase his finishing kick.
Watch Griselda's effort levels in the final furlong given her recent tendency to weaken when the pressure builds.
Observe Grand Citadel's settling pattern, as the trip reduction may see him racing closer to the pace than ideal.

races.paceDynamic: Takincareofbizness is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate in this small field. With Sea Her Excel and Saeculamation likely to sit prominent but not pressure early, Takincareofbizness should get soft fractions through the opening stages. The hold-up brigade of Sweet Echo, Zoustar Dreams, Go Lockers Go and Blueaway will be relying on pace acceleration late, but may find insufficient tempo to close into over this sharp 5f trip. This controlled early pace favours prominent runners who can track and pounce rather than pure hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Takincareofbizness gets easy fractions and kicks clear at the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter will have too much energy left for the late kick, holding off the closers who lack enough pace to reel in. This tactical advantage combined with recent good form makes the front runner hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Her Excel or Saeculamation sit perfectly behind the leader and time their challenge
scenarios.body: Tracking the uncontested leader gives them ideal positioning to strike when Takincareofbizness weakens, avoiding the traffic problems that may hinder hold-up horses. Both have the tactical speed to capitalize on perfect positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Closer Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly in the middle stages creating gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Despite the likely steady early tempo, any mid-race acceleration would set up perfectly for Zoustar Dreams or Go Lockers Go to unleash finishing kicks. Their superior ratings suggest they have the raw ability if the race shape allows.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Takincareofbizness goes too slow and gets swamped by the entire field
scenarios.body: An overly sedate gallop would bring every horse into contention turning for home, creating a messy sprint where any of the seven could prevail. This chaos scenario particularly suits horses with tactical pace like Sweet Echo despite her finishing concerns.

watchPoints.text: Takincareofbizness dictating overly soft fractions through the first half-mile could make him impossible to catch in the closing stages.
Sweet Echo's finishing kick may be compromised by the sharp 5f trip after her 150-day layoff, potentially stopping quickly in final furlong.
Saeculamation's return to turf after poor all-weather form creates uncertainty about whether surface change will revive his prospects.
Go Lockers Go and Zoustar Dreams could find insufficient pace to close into if Takincareofbizness is allowed uncontested early lead.
Sea Her Excel's hood debut and wind surgery recovery make her unexposed on handicap bow with top jockey taking the ride.
